description.narrative: Insatsens mål är att progressiva aktörer i civilsamhället är operativa och motståndskraftiga och arbetar för att förbättra människors tillgång till Sexuell och Reproduktiv Hälsa och Rättigheter.. Insatsen förväntas bidra till att: ­ Progressiva civilsamhällesorganisationer som arbetar för sexuell hälsa och rättigheter är motståndskraftiga och stärkta av flexibel bidragsfinansiering och nätverk för att genomföra sina egna strategier och är engagerade i relevanta sammanhang för samarbete, lärande och påverkansarbete.

The contribution aims to ensure that progressive civil society actors are operational and resilient and work to improve people's access to Sexual and reproductive Health and Rights. The intervention is expected to contribute to (among other thing)­ Progressive civil society organisations working on sexual health and rights are resilient and empowered by flexible grant funding and networks to implement their own strategies and are engaged in relevant contexts for collaboration, learning and advocacy.

The contribution aims to ensure that progressive civil society actors are operational and resilient and work to improve people's access to SRHR. The intervention is expected to contribute to: -Progressive civil society organisations working on sexual health and rights are resilient and empowered by flexible grant funding and networks to implement their own strategies and are engaged in relevant contexts for collaboration, learning and advocacy. -Young people report improved access to relevant information on sexual health and rights in relationships. Some official representatives are open to dialogue on changes to laws, policies and curricula. -There is increased mobilisation for the right to safe abortion and there are fewer negative perceptions about women and young girls having abortions. -There is increased awareness and mobilisation among LGBTI people, women and young people about their sexual and reproductive rights, and discriminatory laws and policies related to sexuality are being challenged in court.
